name: App Store Review Bot
tagline: Checks your iOS app against Apple's review rules before Apple does
description: Built on the lessons of several hundred real refusals, it reads your app and its release setup against Apple's published guidelines and tells you which parts are likely to draw a flag. If a refusal has already landed, it helps you draft the reply and decide what to change before you resubmit.
author: stevederico
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
